description: The mobile platform offers personalised career guidance for Classes 9–12, aligning student choices with NEP 2020 through aptitude, interest and skills-based assessments.
body_lead: The Rajasthan government on Monday said it has launched a mobile application, My Career Advisor , to offer personalised career guidance to students, aiming to help them make informed career choices and plan their future in line with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. The application has been introduced for students from Classes 9 to 12 and is also designed for use by teachers, parents, and career counsellors.
